study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Lin et al., Journal of Affective Disorders, 2023
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Understanding the heterogeneity of dynamic functional connectivity patterns in first-episode drug naïve depression using normative models

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Quantile polynomial regression with second-order (quadratic) polynomial terms was used to estimate percentile curves for normative modeling.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: A quantile polynomial regression model was used to determine percentile curves based on the second-order polynomial regression.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Dynamic functional connectivity within brain networks and network fluctuation characteristics derived from fMRI time-varying connectivity and ICA network weights.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Then, we mapped the heterogeneity of the dynamic features (network fluctuation characteristics and dynamic functional connectivity within brain networks) in the patients group via normative modeling.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Quantile polynomial regression modeled dynamic characteristics as a function of age (including quadratic term) and sex.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text:
A quantile polynomial regression model was used to determine percentile curves based on the second-order polynomial regression.
For the healthy-base participant with index i, sexi encodes the participant's sex (male: 0, female: 1), agei is the modified age of the participant (physical age minus the average age of the healthy-base group).
